items.title: Build the review evidence pack for the execution plan document
items.context: Collect the target document state, current diff, and code-backed truth sources needed for review: prompt registry, agent_prompt, reviewer lanes, review_run_start/finding/pass, init-check gate, evaluator save/eval-evidence, milestone_status UX, process-fact registry, command policy, and existing CLI docs. The evidence pack must explicitly prefer current code facts over stale plan prose.

items.title: Run the 3x2 independent review over the document
items.context: Use Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, and Antigravity CLI as the three host labels. Each host should inspect the document from two lenses: lifecycle/gate correctness and prompt/routing/UX practicality. Reviewers must cite concrete project evidence and identify blockers, risks, and suggested optimizations without treating prompt text as gate evidence.

items.title: Reconcile 3x2 findings into an actionable optimization ledger
items.context: Deduplicate overlapping findings, classify each as accept/reject/defer, identify owner milestone/story impact, and record evidence references. The ledger must explain when a suggestion is rejected or deferred because current code evidence contradicts it.

items.title: Apply approved documentation optimizations without weakening gates
items.context: Update the execution plan only where evidence supports the change. Preserve hard lifecycle gates, reviewer-run binding, evaluator raw-vs-saved evidence boundary, milestone_status UX contract, legacy read compatibility, canonical proof-or-stop-* writes, and no direct story-file artifact mutation by prompts.

items.title: Produce DONE optimization table with reasons and evidence
items.context: Before marking DONE, add or provide a complete table listing each concrete optimization made, why it was made, what project evidence supports it, which 3x2 finding or host/lens motivated it, and whether it changed milestone order, agent responsibility, input/output contract, UX contract, or validation coverage.
